comment: AA 00057 Q10/Q11: the ONE icon table of the journey. The wallet (through the injector: I-1 image/splImage and the injector's token file) uses `base` + file; Night Market's site (FR-022) uses `siteDir` + file, the byte-identical copies it bundles in web/public/token-icons/. `sha256` pins every file (the official-Midnight-symbol set with the badge inside the disc, SHA256SUMS-v3; v2 is superseded); e2e/registry/icons.test.ts holds the site's copies to it and the journey's STEP=icons the published files. Published versions are never overwritten (Q11): a new set is a new `/vN/` base. Generic test-token discs; the badge and midnight.png are the official Midnight symbol (source: evidence/00057-solana-midnight-journey/token-icons/SOURCE.md).
